description: Aerodrome (Montreal Airport) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Geometric and conventional representation of airport facilities for planning purposes. The geospatial “aerodrome” data is structured according to the following layers of information: - CARTO-VOI-AERODROME-TRACK: A defined surface on earth intended to be used, in whole or in part, for the arrival, departure and maneuvers of aircraft. Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are aviation, Plane, Infrastructure, PolearTM, SIRR. It offers 3 resource(s) in GPKG, HTML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
